questions.prompt: What determines the value evaluated by a block expression `{ ... }`?

options.b: Its last expression, provided it has no trailing semicolon

questions.prompt: What happens if you append a semicolon `;` to the final expression inside a block?

options.b: The block evaluates to `()` (the unit type)
options.c: It causes a compiler error in all cases
